construct_CallStackGraph: construct a CallStackGraph from a pandas DataFrame and CallStackIdentity to build a call stack tree
get_path_to_root: get the path from a given node index back to the root of the call stack graph
get_leaf_nodes: get all leaf node indices under a given node in the call stack graph
get_paths_to_leaves: get all paths from a given node to its leaf descendants in the call stack graph
trim_trace_events_with_CallGraph: pre-process trace data with CallGraph to trim child event durations that exceed their parent event end times
